hero.title: FAQ pattern
hero.description: One FAQ component, two rules that both apply to a live FAQ page: how the content is structured and published, and how it behaves for readers without JavaScript.

flat.title: One list
flat.description: A single card with one list of questions.

sectioned.title: Grouped by topic
sectioned.description: Questions grouped by topic, such as adoption, fostering and donations.

data.title: Content and structured data
items: Import `FaqAccordionItem`/`FaqAccordionSection` from `@/components/patterns/FaqAccordion` — never hand-declare an equivalent local shape.
i18n sites: FAQ text lives in `src/locales/{lang}/faq.json`; `src/data/faq.tsx` exports a `getFaqSections(t)` adapter that resolves it into canonical types (it supports embedded `<Trans>` links).
Non-i18n sites: `src/data/faq.ts` exports `faqSections: FaqAccordionSection[]` (or `faqItems: FaqAccordionItem[]` for a single flat list) directly, as this page's own `src/data/faq.ts` does.
`FAQPage` JSON-LD must be computed from the same sections the page renders, via `buildFaqJsonLd()` in `src/lib/faq-json-ld.ts` — never hand-typed as a second, separately-maintained array.
Never attach `FAQPage` JSON-LD to a page that doesn't actually render the corresponding Q&A content.

behavior.title: Behavior and accessibility
items: Preferred for FAQ, informational disclosures, and "learn more" content.
Must work without JavaScript or hydration — content stays readable and expandable with JS off.
Style directly in the page/pattern component; do not require a JS accordion wrapper.
Use a custom accordion only with a documented exception.
Verify keyboard support (Enter/Space on summary) and focus visibility.
